blackjack.title: Blackjack
blackjack.description: Casino blackjack for play credits, drawn by the GPU renderer at 60 fps: a felt table with a leather rail, cards dealt from the shoe, chips, six decks, 3 to 2, double, split, insurance, a strategy hint, statistics. iDrive controller or touch. Parked only.
blackjack.author: custom

lucky_sevens.title: Lucky Sevens
lucky_sevens.description: A five reel slot machine for play credits, drawn by the GPU renderer at 60 fps: glossy symbols, reels that bounce to a stop, ten paylines, WILD, free spins, a progressive jackpot, statistics. iDrive controller or touch. Parked only.
lucky_sevens.author: custom

pit_wall.title: Pit Wall
pit_wall.description: Break the advertising panels off the pit wall: a night race scene drawn by the GPU renderer at 60 fps, the ball on an M front wing, start lights, combos and power-ups. iDrive controller or touch. Parked only.
pit_wall.author: custom

snake.title: Snake
snake.description: Snake on the central display, drawn by the GPU renderer at 60 fps: steer with the iDrive controller (push or turn) or swipe on the screen. Parked only.
snake.author: custom

track_defender.title: Track Defender
track_defender.description: Arcade shooter on the central display, drawn by the GPU renderer at 60 fps: drones attack the track in waves, the M car shoots them down. iDrive controller or touch. Parked only.
track_defender.author: custom
